continuity: Jin’s party reaches Jiangsu after eleven days on the road; the group is exhausted, and Jin insists they continue together rather than travel separately.

Prince Shangshan and Hong Jin are traveling toward the imperial capital in a carriage surrounded by the Embroidered Uniform Guard. Hong Jin fears the Emperor may harm Zhu Bao, whom the late Emperor entrusted to his care.
An unidentified corpse lies ahead of the procession, and Hong Jin hears a familiar voice nearby, prompting hope that Jin’s party has caught up.
plot: After eleven days of grueling travel from the Sichuan Tang Clan, Jin’s exhausted party reaches Jiangsu. Jin refuses to split the group, insisting they must endure and grow stronger together; during a brief rest, he carries Hyuk Mujin while Jeok Cheongang carries Ju Hwaran.

On a guarded carriage bound for the imperial capital, Hong Jin remembers his impoverished childhood and the late Emperor’s charge to protect Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao. Zhu Bao remains confident in his elder brother, but Hong Jin fears the Emperor’s intentions. When the Embroidered Uniform Guard investigates an unidentified corpse ahead, Hong Jin hears a familiar voice and laughs, hoping it belongs to Jin’s party.
translation_decisions: Distinguish 홍건적 as “Red Turban Bandits” from 홍건군 as “Red Turban Army.”

active_continuity: The Divine Physician secured the Blood Soul Gu found in the deceased City Lord of Sichuan Province; it weakens hosts, causes madness, and eventually kills them.
Jin suspects Dark Heaven’s covert killing of the City Lord is part of a scheme targeting the Great Nation, possibly its imperial family.
Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao is traveling toward the imperial capital with Hong Jin and fifty Embroidered Uniform Guard members.
The late Emperor entrusted Hong Jin with Zhu Bao’s care; Hong Jin fears the current Emperor intends harm, while Zhu Bao trusts his elder brother.
Jin’s party reached Jiangsu after eleven days of arduous travel and is exhausted; Jin insists the group stay together.
The Embroidered Uniform Guard’s procession stopped over an unidentified corpse ahead; Hong Jin heard a familiar voice nearby and hopes Jin’s party has caught up.
Jin says he is currently well but may hit a wall again; the Divine Physician is traveling with the party to treat him.
open_questions: Why did Dark Heaven secretly kill the City Lord of Sichuan Province, and is it targeting the Emperor or imperial family?
What does the Emperor intend for Prince Shangshan, and what prompted the imperial decree against Hong Jin?
Who is the unidentified corpse ahead of the procession, and has Jin’s party caught up with Prince Shangshan?
What explains the attackers’ unnatural ferocity during the caravan assault?
